blocks.orig: Africa Safari Ngorongoro Ndutu is a tented camp nestled in Ndutu – an area just south of the famous Serengeti National Park and the scene of the calving season of the Great Migration. After your game drives to witness this impressive spectacle, you can stay in one of the 12 safari tents with ensuite bathrooms, large beds, and private terraces. They are scattered around a central restaurant/ lounge tent for lovely dinners and sundowners. From here, you can take in the views, watch wildlife pass by, and – if you’re lucky – fall asleep to the sounds of the Great Migration.
blocks.html: Africa Safari Ngorongoro Ndutu is a tented camp set in Ndutu – the area just south of the well-known Serengeti National Park where the calving season of the Great Migration takes place. After your game drives to see this impressive spectacle, you sleep in one of the 12 safari tents, each with an ensuite bathroom, large beds and a private terrace. The tents are spread around a central restaurant/ lounge tent where you can enjoy pleasant dinners and sundowners. From the camp you can take in the views, see wildlife go by and – with some luck – drift off to sleep to the sounds of the Great Migration.
